svg.title: LO-World architecture overview
svg.desc: LO-VAE encodes semantic occupancy and hybrid range–voxel LiDAR into shared BEV latents. LO-Former caches historical context and generates future latents with conditional flow matching, guided by ego trajectories and optional layouts. A shared decoder and modality heads jointly predict occupancy and LiDAR. The LiDAR head receives stop-gradient occupancy guidance.
svg.text: One shared representation, from scene history to a controllable future.
